title: Q-HACK INDIA 2026
description:
Q-Hack India 2026
 is a national-level quantum hackathon hosted by QuantumRIT at Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, as part of Quantum Week 2026, a IBM Qiskit Fall Fest program. The hackathon brings together students, developers, researchers and quantum enthusiasts to explore real-world applications of quantum computing. Participants will move from idea to prototype through a competitive build experience, with access to mentorship, technical resources and a platform to showcase their work. Whether you are new to quantum computing or an expert, the challenge is designed to encourage experimentation, practical problem-solving and ambitious ideas. Q-Hack India 2026

title: Hefty-Hacks
description:
Hefty Hacks
 is a fully-online 
Finance × Trading
 hackathon presented by 
TechZap
. Over one intense sprint, engineers, quants and designers turn market chaos into working product — trading systems, market predictors, fintech, risk engines, DeFi and everything in between. Pick a niche. Go absurdly deep. Ship something the street hasn't seen yet. 🌟 
Exclusive Career Opportunity
: The 
Top 10 teams
 will get a chance to participate in direct hiring rounds with leading companies and fast-growing startups. (Selection for interviews and hiring is solely at the discretion of the participating companies and subject to their individual eligibility criteria and recruitment policies.) Finance. Trading. Innovation.
 — one laptop, a thesis worth defending, and 36 hours to prove it. The markets never sleep, and neither do great builders. Hefty Hacks challenges you to build at the intersection of 
finance and trading
 — from high-frequency execution engines to market predictors, robo-advisors, fraud radars and on-chain quant tooling. There's one rule that decides winners: 
go narrow.
 Anyone can build "a trading app." The teams that win pick a niche so specific it sounds obsessive — then own it. Build on either track — or fuse them into something nobody has shipped yet. Reinvent how money moves, grows and stays safe — on-chain or off. Combine both tracks into something genuinely unique. Generating your idea straight from an AI is 
strongly discouraged
 — judges can smell a generated pitch, and a borrowed thesis has no conviction behind it. Instead: Your niche, AI's leverage.
 Originality is the edge we score for. A sharp, unique idea executed well beats a broad idea half-built. Hefty Hacks is built and run by 
TechZap

title: Winter of Code 2026
description: Winter of Code 2026 is an open-source contribution program designed to help students and developers get started with real-world software development and open-source collaboration. Participants will have the opportunity to explore open-source projects, contribute code, fix issues, improve documentation, and collaborate with project maintainers and fellow developers. The program focuses on learning by doing, encouraging participants to build practical development skills, understand real-world Git and GitHub workflows, and make meaningful contributions to the open-source community. Whether you are new to open source or already have development experience, Winter of Code 2026 provides an opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow as a developer. title: HackInverse 1.0
description:

title: QuantHacks
description:
QuantHacks
 is a hackathon organized by the 
London Institute of Actuarial Studies (LIAS)
, bringing together technology, data, and actuarial science to tackle real-world problems involving 
risk, uncertainty, and decision-making
. From cybersecurity and financial technology to education and career development, participants are challenged to build practical solutions using 
artificial intelligence, machine learning, statistics, probability, and predictive analytics
. The goal isn't simply to build another application. It's to use 
quantitative thinking and technology to understand uncertainty, predict outcomes, and make better decisions. 🛡️ 
Cybersecurity

Quantify cyber risk, predict potential incidents, estimate financial losses, or build smarter risk assessment systems. 💰 
FinTech

Build solutions for credit risk, financial planning, insurance pricing, loan defaults, investment decisions, or financial forecasting. 🎓 
EdTech

Apply predictive analytics to student performance, exam preparation, dropout risk, personalized learning, and career planning. Every project should meaningfully incorporate 
actuarial or quantitative principles
, such as: You don't need to build a complicated mathematical model just for the sake of it. The objective is to show how quantitative reasoning 
actually improves your solution
. Bring your ideas, your code, and your curiosity. Build something useful, back your decisions with data, and show us what happens when 
technology meets the mathematics of risk. QuantHacks

title: BOSS Battle
description: Bitshala builds and teaches Bitcoin Open Source Software — that's the "BOSS" in our name, and also the joke behind this one. Between cohort-based learning on Bitcoin's protocol and privacy stack, and the invite-only BOSS Summit that gathers India's sharpest Bitcoin OSS builders twice a year, we've mostly kept things small and deep. BOSS Battle flips that: it's virtual, it's open, and it's a hackathon instead of a summit. You don't need a GitHub history full of BIPs to show up. Beginners get workshops, mentors, and a community that answers questions instead of gatekeeping them. Experienced builders get a chance to finally prototype the thing they've been meaning to build, surrounded by people who actually get it. No stage, no suits — just your terminal and three boss fights between you and the leaderboard. title: Hack On Hills 8.0
description: Welcome to Hack on Hills 8.0, the flagship 48-hour hackathon hosted by the App Team, NIT Hamirpur. Over the years, Hack on Hills has grown into one of North India's largest student-run hackathons, bringing together thousands of developers, designers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts from across the country. This edition explores a defining shift in technology: the rise of autonomous agents. As AI systems evolve from tools that generate content to systems that can reason, plan, and execute tasks, we stand at the beginning of a new computing paradigm. Hack on Hills 8.0 invites participants to build products, platforms, and experiences that leverage this transformation to solve real-world problems. Whether you're building intelligent agents, decentralized applications, sustainable technology solutions, or entirely new ideas, this is your opportunity to turn ambitious concepts into working products. Build systems capable of reasoning, planning, decision-making, and autonomous execution. Develop decentralized applications, protocols, and infrastructure for the next generation of the internet. Create technology solutions addressing environmental, social, and community challenges. Explore bold ideas beyond predefined categories and build solutions that create meaningful impact. Shortlisting: Based on participant profiles and application review Finals: 48-hour in-person hackathon at NIT Hamirpur Participants will collaborate, prototype, and present their projects before a panel of industry experts, mentors, and judges. Hack on Hills 8.0 features a prize pool, sponsor challenges, and ecosystem bounties designed to recognize outstanding innovation across multiple domains. Prize details and partner tracks will be announced soon. With over 1,500+ registrations across previous editions, Hack on Hills continues to foster a community of builders who are passionate about technology, innovation, and problem-solving. title: CodeStorm 2026: FutureForge
description:
CodeStorm 2026: FutureForge is a student-focused innovation hackathon where developers, designers, creators, and problem-solvers come together to build impactful solutions using technology. Unlike traditional hackathons that focus on a single domain, FutureForge embraces 
Open Innovation
, allowing participants to tackle real-world challenges across any field they are passionate about. Whether it's Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Cybersecurity, Education Technology, Sustainability, Productivity Tools, Mobile Applications, or something entirely unique, this is your platform to innovate. This hackathon is part of the 
CodeStorm 2026 Series
, an initiative dedicated to empowering students through hands-on learning, collaboration, and innovation. The event will be conducted completely online through our Discord community. Participation is free, and teams may consist of 
1–6 members
. Participants are encouraged to think boldly, experiment fearlessly, and build projects that create meaningful impact while showcasing technical excellence and creativity. CodeStorm is a student-led initiative dedicated to creating opportunities for young innovators, builders, and creators across India.
